text:
Elaine (People Ops): Heads up — @carlos says he'll be in Bergen, Norway for ~8 weeks starting May 5. Wants to confirm WFH stipend, payroll implications, and any tax/register steps.
Tom (Payroll): ok thanks. Is this a temporary stay on the same employment contract? Any salary/payment change?
Carlos (Eng): Yes same contract, no pay change. Just remote work from Norway for ~8 weeks (May 5–Jul 1). Won't be doing any local consulting.
Elaine (People Ops): Good. Our temporary remote policy allows up to 90 days without changing home base in many countries, but Norway has payroll & tax quirks. We'll need to track dates and expenses.
Maria (Tax): +1. Norway's 183-day rule isn't passed here but employer has potential withholding obligations if we have fixed base or repeated visits. For a single 8-week stay it's usually low risk, but we should log it and keep receipts.
Tom (Payroll): For stipend: we typically prorate monthly WFH allowance into payroll. Since it's <90 days, we can either (A) expense reimbursement for one-off travel costs or (B) prorated payroll stipend. Which does Carlos prefer?
Carlos (Eng): Prefer stipend in payroll if that's simpler. Avoid extra expense ticketing.
Elaine (People Ops): Noted. Tom — can payroll do a 2-month prorated stipend and mark it as taxable local income?
Tom (Payroll): Yes. We'll run 2/12 of the monthly WFH allowance across May/June pay runs. Need Carlos to confirm his temporary address and exact dates by EOD Monday. Also will add a note in payroll record: "temporary Norway stay".
Maria (Tax): Also please ask Carlos to fill out the Temporary Remote Checklist: `/forms/temp-remote` -> fields: name, start_date, end_date, address, emergency contact, work_location_timezone, local health coverage plan.
peopleops-bot: Reminder: if you haven't completed the temp remote checklist, fill `/forms/temp-remote` within 48h. :memo:
Elaine (People Ops): Carlos — two other quick things: (1) confirm whether you'll use Redwood's travel insurance or local coverage for healthcare; (2) any office/PEO contact needed?
Carlos (Eng): I'll use Redwood travel insurance for emergency only. No PEO needed.
Maria (Tax): Ok — because it's under 90 days and no fixed establishment, we won't register a branch. But if another engineer overlaps in Norway for >30 days at same city, escalate to tax@redwood.com.
Tom (Payroll): Action items: Carlos to submit address + forms; payroll will schedule prorated stipend entries.
Elaine (People Ops): I'll log this in our remote tracker and mark as "approved provisional". If anything changes (longer stay or local hiring offers), we'll revisit. :white_check_mark:
Carlos (Eng): Thanks all — will submit the form today and DM Tom the address. :thumbsup:
Elaine (People Ops): Great — closing this thread once payroll confirms stipend entries.
Tom (Payroll): I'll post confirmation in this thread after May payroll run (around 2027-05-15).
Maria (Tax): Adding note: keep travel docs + work calendar in case tax authorities request proof of non-residency.
peopleops-bot: Posted: "Temp Remote Request logged (ID #TR-2027-042)"
Elaine (People Ops): Done — TR-2027-042 attached to Carlos' people record.
